name: scim
label: SCIM 2.0 (Identity)
description: System for Cross-domain Identity Management — enterprise SSO standard

table_notes.scim_users: Core SCIM user resource (RFC 7643 §4.1) with enterprise extension — stores identity, org hierarchy, and provisioning metadata for IdP-pushed accounts.
table_notes.scim_groups: SCIM group resource (RFC 7643 §4.2) representing role or team collections; membership is normalised into scim_group_members.
table_notes.scim_group_members: Junction table resolving the many-to-many relationship between scim_groups and scim_users; each row records when a user was added.
table_notes.scim_schemas: Registry of SCIM schema URNs and their attribute definitions; used by /Schemas endpoint and custom extension negotiation.

scim_users.name: id
scim_users.description: SCIM resource ID — stable UUID assigned by the service provider on creation

scim_users.name: external_id
scim_users.description: Opaque ID set by the provisioning client (IdP); used to correlate records across re-provisions

scim_users.name: user_name
scim_users.description: Unique login identifier (usually email or sAMAccountName) — SCIM userName attribute

scim_users.name: display_name
scim_users.description: Full display name as the IdP wants it shown in UI (may differ from formatted_name)

scim_users.name: family_name
scim_users.description: Surname / last name component of the user's legal name

scim_users.name: given_name
scim_users.description: Given / first name component of the user's legal name

scim_users.name: formatted_name
scim_users.description: Full name in display order (e.g. honorific + given + family), as pushed by the IdP

scim_users.name: emails
scim_users.description: SCIM multi-value email array: [{"value": "...", "type": "work", "primary": true}]

scim_users.name: phone_numbers
scim_users.description: SCIM multi-value phone array: [{"value": "+1-555-...", "type": "work"}]

scim_users.name: active
scim_users.description: Whether the account is enabled; IdP sets false to suspend access without deleting the record

scim_users.name: locale
scim_users.description: IETF BCP 47 locale tag (e.g. en-US, fr-FR) controlling number/date formatting for this user

scim_users.name: timezone
scim_users.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. America/New_York) for scheduling and display purposes

scim_users.name: title
scim_users.description: Job title as stored in the IdP directory (e.g. Senior Engineer)

scim_users.name: organization
scim_users.description: Top-level organisation or company name from the enterprise extension

scim_users.name: department
scim_users.description: Organisational unit or department the user belongs to

scim_users.name: employee_number
scim_users.description: HR system employee ID or badge number from the enterprise extension

scim_users.name: cost_center
scim_users.description: Accounting cost centre code used for chargebacks and reporting

scim_users.name: manager_id
scim_users.description: Self-referencing FK to scim_users.id — the user's direct manager in the org hierarchy

scim_users.name: meta
scim_users.description: SCIM meta object: {"resourceType", "created", "lastModified", "location", "version"}

scim_users.name: created_at
scim_users.description: Timestamp when this record was first provisioned into the service provider

scim_users.name: last_modified_at
scim_users.description: Timestamp of the most recent SCIM PATCH or PUT update to this user record

scim_groups.name: id
scim_groups.description: SCIM resource ID — stable UUID assigned by the service provider on group creation

scim_groups.name: external_id
scim_groups.description: Opaque ID set by the provisioning client (IdP) to correlate the group across re-provisions

scim_groups.name: display_name
scim_groups.description: Human-readable group name as pushed by the IdP (e.g. Engineering, Sales-EMEA)

scim_groups.name: description
scim_groups.description: Free-text explanation of the group's purpose or access scope

scim_groups.name: created_at
scim_groups.description: Timestamp when this group was first provisioned into the service provider

scim_group_members.name: id
scim_group_members.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the membership row

scim_group_members.name: group_id
scim_group_members.description: FK to scim_groups.id — the group this membership belongs to

scim_group_members.name: user_id
scim_group_members.description: FK to scim_users.id — the user being added to the group

scim_group_members.name: added_at
scim_group_members.description: Timestamp when the IdP provisioned this user into the group

scim_schemas.name: name
scim_schemas.description: Short human-readable schema name (e.g. User, Group, EnterpriseUser)

scim_schemas.name: description
scim_schemas.description: Human-readable description of the schema's purpose and scope

short_description: System for Cross-domain Identity Management — enterprise SSO standard
long_description: SCIM 2.0 (RFC 7643/7644) defines how enterprise identity systems provision, manage, and deprovision user and group accounts across applications. The schema covers the core SCIM user profile with enterprise extension (manager hierarchy, org structure, employee ID), group memberships, and the SCIM schema registry for custom extensions.
when_to_use: Use for any enterprise application that needs to synchronize users with corporate identity providers. Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and OneLogin all push users via SCIM. Required for SSO integrations with enterprise customers — most B2B SaaS companies must implement SCIM to close enterprise deals. Essential for Just-In-Time user provisioning.
